In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the fragmentation pathways of 4- oxopentanoic and other small organic compounds bearing acetyl and carboxyl groups are complex and involve a number of different reaction mechanisms, some of which are new and not yet reported in the literature.

the fragmentation mechanisms for small organic compounds with a carboxyl and a carbonyl group in the molecule are very similar to the fragmentation mechanisms observed for small organic compounds having two carbonyl groups.
the fragmentation of 4- oxopentanoic acids proceeds by two main pathways, namely, CO2 elimination and successive water and CO eliminations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a concerted mechanism is found to occur for the elimination of CO2, whereas a stepwise mechanism occurs for the elimination of water and a subsequent rearrangement of the primary anion product leads to CO elimination.
the DFT calculations were able to predict the observed fragmentation pathways and to provide a detailed picture of the fragmentation mechanisms.
the experimental data are in agreement with the theoretical data.

the fragmentation of 4- oxopentanoic anion can be explained using a combination of experimental and theoretical methods.
